Forgotten Pacts.title: Demonic Attributes
Forgotten Pacts.blurb: Modular traits rolled for summoned/encountered demons — 20 Minor, 20 Major. Each may only appear once per demon.

entries.name: Minor (20)
entries.text: Armoured Hide (+1 Armour) · Backstabber (breaks binding on 17+) · Chameleonic (LoS only within 12") · Demonic Strength (counts as 2-handed) · Extra Arms (+1 Fight) · Extra Legs (+1 Move) · Explosive Demise (+3 elemental blast on death) · Horns (+2 Fight charging) · Horrific (Will TN10 to approach) · Levitation (ignores rough ground) · Magic Attack · Magic Vulnerability (-2 Armour vs magic) · Numbing Touch (-1 Fight on loss) · Poisonous · Teleport (random moves become teleports) · Tentacles (free +0 shot at 2") · True Sight (immune to Beauty/Invisibility/Monstrous Form) · Two Heads (fewer supporting-figure bonuses vs it) · Vampiric (heals 2 on hit) · Vestigial Wings (no fall damage)

entries.name: Major (20)
entries.text: Acidic Blood (Will roll or 3 dmg + weapon destroyed) · Beautiful (Will TN15 to attack) · Blinding Aura (Will TN12 within 6" or blinded) · Celerity (activates twice/turn) · Discorporate (splits into 2 minor demons, then imps, on death) · Elemental Absorption (ignores first 5 elemental dmg) · Insubstantial Movement (moves through terrain/dead space) · Invisible · Invulnerability (immune to normal weapons) · Life Bane (Will TN20 within 3" or 2 dmg) · Maelstrom (-2 to shoot it) · Magic Sink (-2 Casting within 12") · Mind Lock (+2 Will, immune to Mind Control) · Mind Wipe (Will TN18 or -2 Will + lost spell) · Petrifying Stare (Petrify-12 aura) · Regenerate (+3 Health/turn) · Serendipitous (all its rolls +1) · Swirling Darkness (+4 Fight vs shooting) · Thousand Young (spawns imps on 1-4 initiative) · Uncontrollable (Will TN20 or breaks control)

Forgotten Pacts.title: Mystic Brands
Forgotten Pacts.blurb: Mystic Brands take an item slot and count as ongoing spells (cancellable by Dispel/Spelleater/null energy). Burning Marks: rolling a natural 1 on a Will roll sends the bearer temporarily insane; may be sacrificed for +1 damage in a strike (at the cost of 2 damage to self). Devotional Marks: +1 to all Will rolls; may be sacrificed for a one-off +3 Will roll.

entries.name: Mark of Rage
entries.text: +2 Move if the move ends in combat.

entries.name: Mark of the Berserker
entries.text: +2 Fight vs multiple foes.

entries.name: Mark of the Blood
entries.text: +2 damage (+3 with a two-hander).

entries.name: Mark of the Chain
entries.text: +3 Will resisting/breaking spells.

entries.name: Mark of the Fang
entries.text: +1 Fight.

entries.name: Mark of Endurance
entries.text: Never Wounded; immune to poison.

entries.name: Mark of Life
entries.text: +2 Fight, +1 Armour vs undead.

entries.name: Mark of Protection
entries.text: Sacrifice to prevent up to 3 damage.

entries.name: Mark of Sight
entries.text: Immune to Invisibility/Beauty/Monstrous Form.

entries.name: Mark of the Shield
entries.text: +1 Armour.

entries.name: Standard vs Dungeon Set-Up
entries.text: Two table-building modes; Dungeon Set-Up adds "dead space" only Immaterial/Burrowing figures can cross.

entries.name: Spells altered underground
entries.text: Crumble (no effect on dead space) · Leap (can't cross dead space) · Mud (only 1.5" radius on stone floors) · Plane Walk (can cross dead space, can't end there) · Wall (collapses on 15+, attackable: Fight roll 12+ destroys it).

entries.name: Doors & Ceilings
entries.text: Doors cost 1 action/2" to open, block LoS, can't be locked. Ceilings cap vertical movement (10" typical).

entries.name: Lighting
entries.text: Max line of sight 20" (or 16" in deep dark) unless under a Glow spell (24").

entries.name: Treasure placement (underground)
entries.text: One player places all tokens; others may move one, pass, or veto the whole layout.

entries.name: Random Encounters (underground)
entries.text: On a treasure's first pickup, roll a die — 14+ spawns a random creature, placed by whoever beats their level in an opposed roll.

entries.name: Burrowing (new ability)
entries.text: Can move through terrain and dead space on random moves as if not there.

Into the Breeding Pits.title: Traps & secret passages
Into the Breeding Pits.blurb: Rolling a natural 1 for initiative springs a trap on any figure the roller chooses; roll the Trap Table below. Trap Experts/Apprentices/Captains/Thieves/Tunnel Fighters get a bonus vs the Trap Number. Secret Passages: rolling a natural 20 for initiative lets that figure (and its activation group) pass straight through vertical terrain, once, on activation.

rows.name: Caltrops
rows.text: Move TN14 or -2 Move until healed.

rows.name: Cement Spray
rows.text: Move TN14 or can't pick up/drop treasure all game.

rows.name: Death From Above
rows.text: Drops a Level 1 Encounter creature onto the target.

rows.name: Disease
rows.text: Fight TN14 or miss the next game.

rows.name: Explosive Rune
rows.text: +5 magic shooting attack on target & everyone within 2".

rows.name: Mind Maze
rows.text: Will TN12 or lose the activation; spreads to anyone entering combat with the target.

rows.name: Nullwave
rows.text: Cancels all spells in play (incl. binds); Will TN14 or 1 damage.

rows.name: Personal Demon
rows.text: Spawns a Will+10 minor demon fixated only on the target.

rows.name: Phosphorescent Spray
rows.text: Move TN16 or glow — shooters get +3, visible to 24" all game.

rows.name: Pick Pocket
rows.text: Fight TN12 or lose held treasure/an item.

rows.name: Pit Trap
rows.text: Move TN14 or fall into a 4" pit.

rows.name: Poison Dart
rows.text: +5 shooting attack; on a hit, one action per activation until healed.

rows.name: Siren
rows.text: Pulls all uncontrolled creatures 6" toward the target.

rows.name: Smoke Bomb
rows.text: 2" smoke cloud; Will TN12 or lose the coming turn.

rows.name: Spring-loaded Axe
rows.text: +3 attack, +2 damage on a win.

rows.name: Teleport Pad
rows.text: Random teleport d20+5" away.

rows.name: Time Slip
rows.text: Will TN12 or vanish from the board until a later TN8 Will roll succeeds.

rows.name: Wall of Force
rows.text: Will TN14 or +0 attack & thrown 5".

rows.name: Whispers
rows.text: Will TN14 or an opponent moves you up to 6".

rows.name: Willsap
rows.text: Will TN14 or Will drops to +0 (or -1) for the game.

The Maze of Malcor.title: Optional core rule updates
The Maze of Malcor.blurb: The 12-scenario campaign also introduces full Sky Gondola vehicle rules (movement, boarding up to 5 figures, combat, Fight+0/Armour14/Health30 as a target, 500–1000gc buy/sell) and an alternate "Forces of Malcor" mode where one player runs Malcor and his monsters as a intelligent opponent instead of uncontrolled creatures.

entries.name: Treasure Placement II
entries.text: One central token, then one per player within 8" of it, then one more anywhere 9"+ from any edge.

entries.name: Securing Treasure
entries.text: Unclaimed tokens at game-end: 15+ on a die secures them for a player with figures still on table.

entries.name: Auto Success/Failure
entries.text: Natural 20 on any Target Number roll auto-succeeds (even Will rolls vs spells); natural 1 auto-fails.

entries.name: Experience Table II
entries.text: +5 failed cast w/ damage · +10 successful cast (Casting No. >6) · +40 per game played · +50 per treasure secured · +5 per uncontrolled kill (cap 50). Game cap 300 XP.

entries.name: Casting Roll floor
entries.text: A successful Casting Roll is treated as the actual roll or 14, whichever is higher.

entries.name: Scrolls rework
entries.text: Cast an unknown spell, or insure a known one against failure — either way treat the Casting Roll as exactly 12.

entries.name: Uncontrolled Creature Actions II
entries.text: Adds a ranged-attack priority step before "move toward closest figure."

entries.name: Balancing Scenarios
entries.text: 6+ level gap between wizards spawns a random creature controlled by the lower-level player.

entries.name: Black Market Contacts
entries.text: Purchasing options are limited to 4 rolls on the Treasure Table (ignoring gold) after each game.

entries.name: Creating Experienced Wizards
entries.text: Formal step-by-step process to build a wizard above level 0 for a mid-campaign join or one-off.

The Maze of Malcor.title: The Pentangle — five lost schools
The Maze of Malcor.blurb: Not intended as playable wizard schools — their spells exist only on scrolls found in the Collegium — but rules are included for using them as full schools if a group agrees.

rows.name: Astromancer
rows.text: Combines Sigilist + Elementalist · Aligned with Elementalist, Sigilist

rows.name: Distortionist
rows.text: Combines Illusionist + Summoner · Aligned with Illusionist, Summoner

rows.name: Fatecaster
rows.text: Combines Soothsayer + Witch · Aligned with Soothsayer, Witch

rows.name: Sonancer
rows.text: Combines Chronomancer + Enchanter · Aligned with Chronomancer, Enchanter

rows.name: Spiritualist
rows.text: Combines Necromancer + Thaumaturge · Aligned with Necromancer, Thaumaturge

entries.name: Alignment / Meteor Strike / Misalignment / Shape Starfire Elemental / Starfall / Starfire Bolt
entries.text: Health-on-cast synergy, a +7 shooting blast, self-damaging spellstorm, summonable elemental, area mines, and a +4 elemental bolt.

entries.name: Break Armour / Collapse / Fracture / Implode-Explode / Misstep / Whiplash
entries.text: Armour destruction, a +4 terrain-based blast, a combat-only free attack, mass pull/push, pre-game enemy reposition, and a movement teleport.

entries.name: Blood Wager / Fickle Finger / Mischance / Scatter / Serendipity / True Gold
entries.text: Coin-flip full heal or half-Health loss, action-count randomizer, forced disadvantage/advantage rolls, treasure-token shove, and a treasure reroll.

entries.name: Charm / Imbue Instrument / Humming Blade / Steal Voice / Sound Cloud / Sound Wave
entries.text: Animal pacify, an instrument that can become a permanent +2 Will item, armour-shredding weapon buff, spellcaster silence, melee debuff aura, and a knockback shot.

entries.name: Call Wraith / Command Ethereal / Ethereal Form / Inhabit / Nightmare / Speak with the Dead
entries.text: Summons a wraith, puppeteers ethereal undead, grants temporary ethereal form, possesses a construct/undead, curses a rival's XP long-term, and boosts a future Out of Game cast.

Thaw of the Lich Lord.title: Lichdom — failing the cast
Thaw of the Lich Lord.blurb: Lichdom — Necromancer / 20 / Out of Game. Only a wizard may cast it, tearing his soul from his body to animate his own corpse. Success makes him a Lich outright; failure is punishing and scales with how badly the roll was missed: A successful Lich is subject to a distinct rules package for the rest of the campaign — effectively a third alongside Demonic Pacts and Beastcrafter as a mutually-flavored "wizard state":

rows.text: -1 level, -1 Health stat.
-3 levels, -2 Health, -1 Will, 1 random permanent injury.
-5 levels, -3 Health, -2 Will, 2 random permanent injuries.
-8 levels, -6 Health, -2 Will, 3 random permanent injuries.
The wizard's soul is lost — unrecoverable by any means.

The Perilous Dark.title: Solo & co-op toolkit
The Perilous Dark.blurb: Also codifies house style for "boss monsters" (make them multi-step puzzles, not just high stat-lines — and make them immune to Mind Control) and gives explicit guidance that solo/co-op tables should run less crowded than a normal Frostgrave table, since the simple creature AI can't exploit terrain the way a player can.

entries.name: Warband building
entries.text: Solo: build a warband as normal. Co-op: each player's wizard gets only 200gc and a max of 4 soldiers, so two players together land close to a solo warband's power.

entries.name: Objectives over treasure
entries.text: Place only 2 treasure tokens solo (3 co-op) in hard-to-reach spots, and shift most of the XP budget onto scenario-specific goals (e.g. "+80 XP if the statue is destroyed") to keep games from becoming a pure gold-count.

entries.name: New turn sequence
entries.text: Wizard Phase → Creature Phase I (creatures with Fight +5 or Health 20+) → Apprentice Phase → Creature Phase II (everyone else) → Soldier Phase — lets dangerous monsters act before the party's own soldiers.

entries.name: Updated creature AI
entries.text: Creatures activate in current-Health order, always move to engage the highest-level spellcaster if one move can do it, never intentionally pick a multi-combat, and all creatures get a flat +2 Will.

entries.name: Limited Duration spells
entries.text: Circle of Protection, Invisibility, Monstrous Form, and Wall: roll a die at the end of any turn they're active — on a 1–10 the spell ends early (replaces Wall's normal end-of-turn roll).

entries.name: Target Points
entries.text: Instead of random movement, uncontrolled creatures head for a designer-nominated point (usually the objective) — makes the AI feel purposeful instead of aimless.

entries.name: Monster spawning
entries.text: Bespoke per-scenario spawn tables (not the core random-encounter table) tied to numbered spawn points, so the designer controls both what shows up and where.

entries.name: Clue Markers
entries.text: Treasure-token-like markers that reward investigation (an action + a roll on a scenario-specific clue table) — the game's investigation/mystery layer.

entries.name: Room Cards
entries.text: Draw a card to set up the next room only when a door is opened, so players never see the whole table at once; can also define room shape/doorway count for a lightweight dungeon crawl.

entries.name: Closely Connected Scenarios
entries.text: Rules for chaining scenarios back-to-back without a return to base: partial healing (+6 or half Health), no buying/selling/hiring, one Out of Game spell each.

The Perilous Dark.title: Dungeon crawl systems
The Perilous Dark.blurb: Two full worked examples ship with the book: The Vaults (a fixed 10-card dungeon deck with two objective rooms — a treasure hoard and a stairway down) and Dungeons Deep (the fully randomly-generated version, with its own room/encounter/treasure tables and the Gateway Home rule in action).

entries.name: Dungeon Cards
entries.text: Like Room Cards but smaller and more numerous (10–12 sections instead of 3–5 rooms); the deck is split into a "multi-exit" pile and an "objective room" pile, then interleaved so objectives can't appear too early.

entries.name: Randomly Generated Dungeon
entries.text: Each new room triggers three rolls — a room table, an encounter table, and a treasure/clue table — for a fully improvised dungeon; includes a Will TN20 "search for a secret door" rule to rescue dead-ended layouts.

entries.name: Gateway Room / Home
entries.text: The randomly generated dungeon's designated exit: only spawns once 6+ rooms are revealed, guarded by a double encounter roll, and is the sole way off the table.
